import html # Basic HTML template with a placeholder for user content html_template = """ Visitor Page

Welcome!

{user_content}
""" def create_html_response(visitor_content: str) -> str: """ Construct an HTML page embedding the provided visitor content. The function escapes all characters that could be interpreted as markup to prevent cross‑site scripting (XSS) attacks. Parameters: visitor_content (str): User supplied content to embed in the page. Returns: str: The complete HTML response with safe user content inserted. """ # Escape the visitor content to neutralise any embedded markup or scripts safe_content = html.escape(visitor_content, quote=True) # Insert the escaped content into the template return html_template.format(user_content=safe_content)
